_note: Global game settings, start state and timers. Times are in hours unless a key says minutes.
title: Mysteryless Island

log: You wake alone on a deserted shore. No ship remains; forest rises inland.
Cold sand beneath your cheek. The sea is empty; trees line the dunes.
You wash ashore, soaked and alone. A dark forest stands inland.

deathLog: Your strength fails, and the world recedes from view.
The shore and sky lose their colour; presently even their outlines disappear.
Consciousness deserts you, and the island is lost to darkness.
_sleep: Every sleep ends at 06:00. At zero energy or 00:00, unfinished work stops and you collapse here.

collapse.title: You passed out
collapse.text: Exhaustion leaves you sleeping on the ground at {place}.

sleep.midnight: Midnight. Exhaustion forces you to sleep where you stand.
sleep.exhausted: Your energy is gone. You collapse where you are and sleep until morning.

early_warm_bed.text: At {place}, you sleep early, sheltered by a fire. Energy: {energy}%.

early_unheated_bed.text: At {place}, you sleep early, sheltered but cold. Energy: {energy}%.

late_warm_bed.text: After midnight at {place}, a fire warms your rest. Energy: {energy}%.

late_unheated_bed.text: After midnight at {place}, you sleep without fire. Energy: {energy}%.

exposed_bed.text: Your bed at {place} offers no shelter. Energy at dawn: {energy}%.

ground.text: You sleep on bare ground at {place}. Energy at dawn: {energy}%.

_provisions: Eat and drink from carried supplies at this hunger/thirst; warn once per shortage.

provisions.title: Supplies running low
provisions.hunger: Food exhausted. Find a meal before your strength fails.
provisions.thirst: Water exhausted. Find fresh water or refill your can.
provisions.both: Food and water exhausted. Both must be found without delay.

preparation.text: Raw fish and meat cannot safely serve as provisions. You may preserve them upon a drying rack, a process requiring twelve hours, or cook them over a fire if your need is urgent.

_ending: the end screen (death is permanent): {time} and {day} in survived, {cause} in cause

ending.title: The journal ends
survived: You endured {time} upon the island; on day {day}, your account came to an end.
For {time} you survived in this unknown land. The journal closes upon day {day}.

_journal: lines the engine writes itself; {place} is the name of the place

walkTo: You set out in the direction of {place}.
You make your way across the island towards {place}.
wayOpens: A practicable route to {place} has been discovered.
The ground now offers a passage towards {place}.
You have at last determined how to reach {place}.
nothingNew: The ground yields no sign that has escaped your earlier attention.
For the present, there is nothing more to discover.

_tasks: the note when a task is done: {task}; what changed: {item} {where} {place} {action}

tasks.title: Task done: {task}
tasks.opened: A practicable route to {place} has been discovered.

_newPlace: a place new on the map ({place}): text under the finding that opened it (or a note titled title), and go, the button that walks there

newPlace.title: A new place
newPlace.text: Your examination has revealed a route to {place}. You may proceed there now, or return by way of the map at a later hour.

_tools: tool tags: the label next to the items that have it, and what a { "tool": tag } requirement asks for (without naming an item)

fire_starter.label: fire starter
fire_starter.needs: something to make a fire with

timers.name: fire
warnLog: The fire has diminished to an uncertain flame.
The flames sink low among the embers.
Only a few wavering tongues of fire remain.
expireLog: The fire expires, leaving a bed of glowing embers.
The last flame disappears, and the embers slowly lose their light.
The hearth is cold; a narrow thread of smoke marks where the fire had been.
